notes.title: Unveiling the Galaxy Tour, a single-player quest for intergalactic glory
notes.content:
Get ready to go one-on-one with the universe. Ahead of its upcoming launch, Dunk Dunk is unveiling Galaxy Tour, a single player or co-op experience designed for players who want to work on their skills and rise from backyard baller to cosmic icon, one stylish dunk at a time. 
 
[h2]What is Galaxy Tour? [/h2]
Galaxy Tour is a structured campaign which takes players across eight escalating stages of chaos. Each challenge pushes players to adapt and evolve, with random mutators, platforming obstacles, and increasingly fierce opponents. 
 
[h2]It’s Not Just About Winning – It’s About Winning Over the Crowd [/h2]
Every dunk and block aren’t just for the scoreboard; it’s for the fans. The more stylish your performance, the more fans you’ll earn. Want to make it to the top? You’ll need more than just a bounce in your step; you’ll need brains and maybe a little bit of luck. 
 
Can you break the million-fan threshold? 

[h3]Key Features of Galaxy Tour: [/h3]
[list]
[*] 8 hand-crafted stages, each more challenging than the last 
[*] Randomized mutators and platforming hazards to keep every game fresh 
[*] Fan scoring system rewards creativity, combos, and clutch plays 
[*] Progressively tougher opponents scale with your growing fame 
[*] Designed to be highly repayable and endlessly entertaining 
[/list]
To get a first taste of The Galaxy Tour, tune into the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/blueandqueenie]BlueandQueenie[/url] stream at [u]3pm BST / 7am PDT / 10am EDT[/u] TODAY and check out the brand new video from [url=https://www.youtube.com/@stumpt]Stumpt[/url].
 
[h2]Coming Soon with Dunk Dunk’s Full Launch [/h2]
Galaxy Tour will be available as part of Dunk Dunk’s full game at launch, offering a robust solo experience right out of the gate, perfect for players looking to train, test themselves, through the wackiest basketball courts in the galaxy. 
 
Follow along for more reveals as launch day approaches! 
 
[i]Remember: It’s dunk… or be dunked (on).[/i]

notes.title: Dunk Dunk is Remote Play ready for Next Fest! Lil Gator Cameo!
notes.content:
Sup folks!

Happy Steam Next Fest! If you're hearing about Dunk Dunk for the first time, let me get you up to speed... Dunk Dunk is a chaotic basketball party game for 1-4 players! Think Smash Bros. platforming x Rocket League but make it basketball.

You may have seen us run a few playtests over the last few months but for Next Fest we're dropping a FULL multiplayer mode demo, including all current maps and mutators! 

[b]"What on earth is a mutator?"[/b] I hear you ask, well, mutators are gameplay modifiers in Dunk Dunk that allow you to mix up or "mutate" (see?) the game in a variety of cool ways, for example: what if the basketball was actually a sawblade that sticks to walls and fires in a straight line? What if there was moon gravity? What if the goals teleported around randomly? What if you turned all of these on at once? All of those questions have answers in Dunk Dunk!

[h3]Remote Play Ready![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44158742/c3e3c89151c508d478a30637f4a99fca81c24467.gif[/img]

While Dunk Dunk doesn't currently have a "true" online multiplayer mode, you CAN try the game remotely with your friends using Steam's Remote Play feature! We've recently tried this out with the game's two developers (both confusingly called Nick... or is that easier?) and asked them some questions about Dunk Dunk while they tried to beat us!

[previewyoutube=tK_g_3U_M1I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Lil Gator joins the cameo roster![/h3]

Everyone's favourite lil green adventurer is back and they've got DUNKS! Try Lil Gator as part of the Dunk Dunk roster today!

[previewyoutube=bdEohF2S6ro;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2410590/Dunk_Dunk/

notes.title: Dunk Dunk Playtest Update 1!
notes.content:
Good day, folks!

First of all, big love to anyone reading this who has already tried Dunk Dunk! 

If you haven't yet, here's 15 minutes of me challenging my boss to the last playtest!

[previewyoutube=W_QANXJENm4;full][/previewyoutube]

With that out the way, it's time for our first update to the Dunk Dunk playtest that we're running right now!

This time, we're giving you a new map "SubLab" which features more platforms and a wicked water effect to throw you off course. We're also mixing up the game with new mutators, swap out the regular ball for a saw blade that sticks into surfaces and/or turn on moon gravity to really get some height on those DUUUUUNKS

So what are you waiting for? What? A convenient link to take you to the Dunk Dunk page, placed directly at the end of this article? Easy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2410590/Dunk_Dunk/
